notes.title: Critical bugs fixed!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We recently released an update for Christmas Fables: Holiday Guardians Collector's Edition that addresses many of the issues you reported in discussions and reviews.

Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us, so please don’t hesitate to share your thoughts or report issues with any of our other games—we read and take note of everything!

Thank you for your continued support and for helping us make our games even better!
